target.title: test(infra): add unit tests for executable token normalization
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `exec-wrapper-tokens.ts` module normalizes executable tokens for wrapper and policy matching, handling cross-platform path differences and Windows executable suffixes. Without tests, the normalization logic could silently regress.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add unit tests for `basenameLower` and `normalizeExecutableToken` covering POSIX paths, Windows paths, suffix stripping (.exe/.cmd/.bat/.com), non-executable extensions, and edge cases.

## User Impact

Executable token normalization now has comprehensive test coverage, reducing regression risk.

## Evidence

Direct behavior probe with real function calls:

```text
$ node --import tsx -e "import('./src/infra/exec-wrapper-tokens.js').then(({basenameLower,normalizeExecutableToken})=>console.log(JSON.stringify([{f:'basenameLower',i:'/usr/bin/Node',r:basenameLower('/usr/bin/Node')},{f:'normalizeExecutableToken',i:'node.exe',r:normalizeExecutableToken('node.exe')},{f:'normalizeExecutableToken',i:'C:\Program Files\node.exe',r:normalizeExecutableToken('C:\Program Files\node.exe')}])))"
[{"f":"basenameLower","i":"/usr/bin/Node","r":"node"},{"f":"normalizeExecutableToken","i":"node.exe","r":"node"},{"f":"normalizeExecutableToken","i":"C:\Program Files\node.exe","r":"node"}]
```

Targeted test:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/exec-wrapper-tokens.test.ts

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  9 passed (9)
  Duration  385ms
```

```text
$ npx oxfmt --check src/infra/exec-wrapper-tokens.ts src/infra/exec-wrapper-tokens.test.ts
Checking formatting...

All matched files use the correct format.
Finished in 114ms on 2 files using 8 threads.
```

